title: Local surjectivity of tensor sections
statement: For a scheme X and an epimorphism ψ : G ⟶ H of X-modules, the induced morphism of ULift-valued tensor-section presheaves is locally surjective on the small étale site. The module category is [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], X is [def-pc-scheme], and the normalized tensor-section presheaves are [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial]. The given natural transformations are required to have exactly the tensor-pullback maps as components; they are not arbitrary morphisms.

proof.text: For each etale object U, use the adjunction of [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] to make tensorPullback U.hom a left adjoint, so it preserves the given epimorphism. Apply the covering criterion in [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-space-module-exactness-local-lifting] to that pulled-back map and the section lowered from ULift, obtaining opens V_i covering all of U and local lifting equations.

Transport each local lift using [lem-sc-etale-tensor-sections-open-lift]. The given component equation hβ identifies its tensor-pullback image with the component of β. The definitions and restrictions of [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial] identify this with a member of the image sieve after applying ULift.up. The open inclusions cover U and hence generate a covering etale sieve by Mathlib Scheme.ofArrows_mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff. The image sieve contains this sieve, so it is covering.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleTensorSections_locallySurjective {X : Scheme.{u}} {G H : X.Modules}
    (ψ : G ⟶ H) [Epi ψ]
    (β : etaleTensorSectionsPresheaf G ⟶ etaleTensorSectionsPresheaf H)
    (hβ : ∀ U : X.Etaleᵒᵖ, β.app U = ((tensorPullback U.unop.hom).map ψ).app ⊤) :
    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective X.smallEtaleTopology
      (Functor.whiskerRight β AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u})
